purpose: Teach: 魅了/足らず/斜面/淡路/崖/持ち上げ/高温/ひき

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の演奏、本当に、皆、魅了されたよね、文化祭で、すごかった。
lines.en: Your performance at the culture festival really captivated everyone, Riku. It was incredible.
lines.style: Warm but genuine admiration. Direct eye contact. Slight lift in the middle on 'captivated.' Not overselling—she means it quietly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。練習時間、足らずに、悔しい思いも、あったぜ、桜。
lines.en: Yeah. I wish I'd had more practice time though. I'm still frustrated about that.
lines.style: Quiet, self-critical. Pause after 'Yeah'—he's weighing whether to admit the regret. Soft on the ending, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: スキー教室、急な斜面、怖かったよね、私、何度も、転んだもん。
lines.en: That ski class with the steep slope was terrifying, wasn't it? I kept falling.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh underneath. Quick delivery on the falling part—lightening it with humor. Slight shake in the voice, like reliving the embarrassment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、家族で、淡路島、行くんだ、楽しみだよ、俺、玉ねぎ、楽しみ。
lines.en: My family's going to Awaji Island over summer break. I'm really looking forward to it—especially the onions.
lines.style: Unguarded enthusiasm breaks through. Slightly awkward pivot to 'onions'—he's genuinely excited but a bit embarrassed by how eager he sounds. Lighter pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏の合宿、崖の上の宿、絶景だったよね、覚えてる、リク?
lines.en: That cliff-top inn during summer camp had such an amazing view. Do you remember it, Riku?
lines.style: Softer, nostalgic tone. Draws out 'remember'—she's testing whether he holds the same memory. Vulnerable underneath the casual question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、重いリュック、自分で、持ち上げてたな、すごいよ、桜。
lines.en: You carried that heavy backpack all by yourself. That was really impressive.
lines.style: Genuine, unguarded. Admiration without fanfare. Slower pace—he's looking at her while he says it, a small moment of respect breaking through his usual cool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 高温警報の日、外、出ないようにって、先生も、注意してたよ、最近。
lines.en: With those heat warnings lately, the teachers keep telling us not to go outside. It's been intense.
lines.style: Conversational, slightly concerned undertone. Measured pace. Noticing aloud—the way she brings up practical things when there's something else on her mind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、ひき肉の包み焼き、お母さん、作ってくれたんだ、美味かった。
lines.en: My mom made ground meat wraps for my lunch the other day. They were really good.
lines.style: Warm, unselfconscious. Nostalgic for a small thing. Soft ending—he's not performing gratitude, just remembering something that mattered.
